notes.title: The New AI DEMO version 0.83
notes.content:
[h1]New AI[/h1]
After introducing the new normal attack types in the last update the AI felt too weak.
I had a look at Attack and Defend patterns and found that the AI was structured wrong so decisions were made too slow and with the wrong info.
I restructured the decision making to something like this. (see flow chart)
Each fighter now has a "reaction time", "decision time", "chance of defense" and "chance of attack".
This makes them feel way more responsive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/8027080d9b3ee8bf67f4c477765605addb99de7e.png[/img]
When choosing an attack action the AI then selects patterns based on first distance then health (does the AI have attacks used only with low or high health). Then the list of available actions are sorted by priority and an action is selected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/3ae609a8ef4a7e868e606bec85fe9746d4fecd1a.png[/img]
Defensive actions are selected based on type of attack and sometimes distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/63da43f1c5b5b17fbac12d8f4bdef62327a9a0af.png[/img]
I also wanted to simplify the patterns and have fewer of them.
A pattern is a sequence of button, d-pad inputs the AI gets and how long the button press is.
Before they would have pretty long sequences.

[h2]Example:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Back for 0.2 sec.
[*] South button 0.3 sec.
[*] Forward 0.4 sec.
[*] South button 0.3 sec.
[*] North button 0.3 sec.
[/list]
This would look great when uninterrupted. But for fighters that can "react to attacks" (from medium difficulty and up) they would get interrupted and they would have to make a new decision mid attack. Or for fighters that won’t react on hit they would sometimes be suck in the sequence and look a bit dumb.
 
[h1]New hit and hurt detection[/h1]
While working on the AI and watching a lot of AI fighting AI I started noticing that the hit and hurt detection was off. It took me a while but I found out why.
It has now been fixed and combat feels more responsive now.

[h1]New AI patterns and rebalancing of fighters[/h1]
All fighters have now been given new AI patterns that use the new system.
Their speed has also been tweaked to add greater variation.
Also some fighters now have a dive kick.

[h1]The low kick and block able attacks[/h1]
Low attack now works like a Dragon Punch launching an enemy into the air.
It is also an Invincible Attack.
Now that we have invincible attacks some SUPERs like Orwells van of friends are now invincible since it can be avoided by jump.
Other SUPERS like Christie's Line for lighting are still blockable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/c10bf248481407723e4a8c7e43002caf13aea542.gif[/img]

[h1]Color Variation to Enemies[/h1]
I’ve also added some new color variations to the enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/ad7a13610f7d696f0b7fd15401bcdd52f7041f3f.png[/img]

[h1]New rules[/h1]
Persistent health doing a run.
The biggest change to the game is that now you keep the health you have after a fight. No more getting free health after each fight. This makes the Health cards way more important.
The health cards have also been boosted a bit to not make it too punishing.
There is now a shop open from day 1, so you can buy extra health cards from the first night.

[h1]New tutorial[/h1]
With all these new changes a new tutorial was needed.
So I've added an exploration of the combat UI and an introduction to the city.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/19a9668cb7ada369bc53eec8bd2b148d0b492a44.png[/img]

The next update will focus on enemy fighters, city activities and the length of the demo.

notes.title: New demo! New design!
notes.content:
It took a while but the next update of Mutant Karate Canary is finally ready.
I spend a lot of time trying to figure out what that game should be more than a gem fighter.
And I think I got something great here.

[h1]How to play MKC[/h1]

[h2][b]The Hideout[/b][/h2]
You start out in the “Heroes Hideout”. Here you can learn how to fight on the Arcade Machine, check out the cards you have unlocked on The Board and maybe play the piano? 

You can also check the calendar to keep track of the days and nights.

There will be more stuff in the final game like a Map of the world, TV, fridge etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/c46b3c963b5953e07d24cb25b65ede62d913e316.gif[/img]

[h2][b]The City[/b][/h2]
When you are done exploring the Hideout you can go into the night.

On your way out you select which fighter you want to play as.

Each fighter has their characteristics and even their own car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/df52ddbcd6b8939af6fe4862fad22be2eba8187d.gif[/img]

As you exit, the night begins and Master Due Ven will give you a card to help you in the fight against evil.

When you get a card you can assign it to your fighter in the Deck Menu and the fighter will play that card in the next fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/b2e74483f5a33bcafaa999b887af1b73ddb1e0d5.gif[/img]

You can drive around and look for fights, cards and other events.

The city is filled with events for you to complete.
The demo features:
[list][*]Three zones with minions and a bossfight
[*]Car chases
[*]Treasure chests
[*]Coins
[*]And shops[/list]

As you fight crime your Night XP will grow and you might even level up, letting you select a special card.

[h2][b]The Fight[/b][/h2]
When you find a fight you should assign Cards to you fighter before the fighting begins.
Cards will be played as described on the card.

Some cards play at the beginning for the fight, others when you lose health. For example giving you a health boost when you are down to 25%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/8b978962c3dbf63bae703d043d5e7cf25f181609.gif[/img]

You can collect Mutagens to level up your special moves while fighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/dd621967696c6cea9fd3e0cdc8627971df00f085.gif[/img]

When you win you earn Night XP. 
                    
[h2][b]Death[/b][/h2]
If you get Knocked Out in a fight, don’t worry. You will wake up in the Hideout ready for another night.

When you wake up you Night XP will transfer into real XP and unlock new Cards and Fighters for your next run.
In this Demo you can only play the first 3 nights.
But if you want to try again you can. Just go to the main menu and Reset the game to start again from day 1 again.

notes.title: Devlog 5 - May. 19th. 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Story Mode:[/h1]
I finally started working on what I think will be the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/d7463f2627a5a84530d241b5061024d0ac6f39a1.gif[/img]

In short the mode is:

[olist]
[*] A story mode where you explore a map.
[*] Complete fights or Challenges to earn fame.
[*] Fame gains you access to tournaments.
[*] When you win tournaments you unlock new Characters or Maps.
[/olist]

[h1]Fame, Coins, Buffs and Permanents:[/h1]
The economies needed for this to be fun are Coins and Fame.

A Coin works like a “continue” so if all your fighters fall you can use a coin to revive one of them. 

Fame is a level system. After each fight you gain points the points are converted into fame points (I do this so you can have a Buff that gives you “x2 fame” and then doubles your point to fame conversion rate). You will x amount of Fame points to get the next Fame Level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/7a196f52ac4025dfa509c102fb987d9af62181eb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/03b4afa141e0d0577d800b269900839fdef24f9a.png[/img]

Buffs are buffs :)
You can assign up to three at the time to a fighter.
They trigger  by themselves when the fight is happening and have a certain amount of times they can be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/5f8da67e22b2e181ab2b1eb16d3f0a129f242689.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/65c9e9b5089561060a3e87450b0f07563b06ac6c.png[/img]

Permanents are buffs that you assign and can’t remove again. They alter base damage, base health etc.

[h1]Auto fighting and AI:[/h1]
Since AI vs AI fighting has been so much fun to work on. I watch a few fights every day.
I also added an “Auto Fight” option to this mode.
I don’t know if it will be in for the final version but for now I enjoy prepping my fighters and watching them fight.

That’s all for now, no new demo yet but I hope you enjoyed the small update.
Remember to wishlist!

notes.title: Devlog 3 - March. 20th. 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Survival Mode:[/h1]
It is finally here! The first version of SURVIVAL MODE.

The rules are simple.

[list]
[*] You fight one round against a random fighter
[*] If you win you get the option to either.
[*] Keep Yellows collected
[*] Keep Reds collected
[*] Keep Supers earned
[*] Or add 30% to you health
[*] The difficulty scales each fight
[/list]
How many wins can you get?

In survival mode you can fight the new fighter Dough and Mom.

There are also a few more arenas to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/1b550cee37d36427ef23e02ec3169b8196d637e9.gif[/img]


[h1]Dough and Mom:[/h1]
This new fighter is amazing.

Right now he is only available to fight against in survival mode.

If you want to fight as Dough yourself you’ll have to wait a bit longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/b747bd8a3c41caba1cea0371c556cd4a751f100a.gif[/img] 

[h1]New Controls:[/h1]
There were some problems with registering input for Keyboard Player 2.

So I’ve changed the buttons a bit.

[h2]Player 1 Keyboard[/h2]
[list]
[*] WASD to control direction
[*] B i Jump and In-Air-Attack
[*] G is Power One
[*] Y is Power Two
[*] H Is SPECIAL
[/list]

[h2]Player 2 Keyboard [/h2]
[list]
[*] Arrow Keys to control direction
[*] M is Jump and In-Air-Attack
[*] , is Power One
[*] . is Power Two
[*] - Is SPECIAL
[/list]

[h1]Gem Fighter:[/h1]
The game has changed a lot and now you can finally try it for yourself. so I’ll add the rules here again if you didn’t read the last devlog.

[h2]The New Rules of The Game:[/h2]
Heavily inspired by the Gem system in puzzle fighter mini mix.

[h2]The Mutagens:[/h2]
A successful hit might spawn a mutagen.
Each fighter can now upgrade special attacks by collecting Mutagens, red or yellow.
Each fighter can upgrade each super 2 times.

This means Orwell’s fireball can be upgraded to a bigger fireball (level 2) and if you collect even more to a laser attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/f16b44d40b346e5477eb2a1a0155cdb2f50e5092.gif[/img]


[h2]The Pizza:[/h2]
You can now collect pizza and gain a little health back.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41771943/5202ae6a09d68c84a61ea1de6f9b50da5e93b649.gif[/img]

[h2]New AI:[/h2]
I made a new system for AI.
The new system is run by AI patterns, making it possible to program button combinations.

[h3]Current patterns:[/h3]
[list]
[*] For each Character Unique 
[*] Attack pattern
[*] Defend pattern
[*] Collect Health item
[*] Collect Mutagens to level up
[/list]

Which pattern that is selected is based on distance to the opponent and if the opponent is currently attacking.
Also if health is low and health items in the scene “Collect Health item” will run.
The AI will also try and look for opportunities to go for a Mutagen to level up attacks.
